violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. Dirty wiping cloth found on the counter. Dirty wiping cloths should be laundered.

Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not provided in sufficient number and/or not accessible to allow convenient use by employees. Handwashing sink in dish room was found not working. Handwashing sink should be operational at all times.

Demonstration of knowledge by person in charge. — --Person in charge did not demonstrate adequate knowledge of the food service code requirements. Person in charge stated that reheated items needed to be cooked to 160F when asked. She also did not know the proper time for reheating items. Potentially hazardous foods should be reheated to 165F with-in 1 hour.

Duties of person in charge. — --Person in charge did not ensure employee compliance with an aspect of the food service operation specified in the food service code. Cooking temperatures were not checked for items on roller grill and sausage gravy in hot hold unit. Temperatures should be checked on all heated items before serving to make sure they are properly heated. Person in charge should make sure that food temperatures are checked before they are ready for purchase.
